description: The boat computer itself: memory, SD wear, throttling, clock, and whether we are still recording.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "signalk")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "environment.rpi.cpu.temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["self"] == "true")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: (r._value - 273.15) * 9.0 / 5.0 + 32.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
